subject: Welcome to Avicenna
body:
Dear Anna-Maria,


I hope you are doing well. 


My name is Sara from Avicenna. We've received your request for a meeting. Thank you for your interest in our product and for sharing information about your project with us. We'd be happy to help you with your study.


We built Avicenna to allow researchers and clinicians to automate their research work including field deployment, data collection, and monitoring. We’ve created a slide deck to highlight some of the features of our product.


You can easily implement your ESM study in Avicenna and send as many surveys as needed during your study. Additionally, you can record voice messages in the surveys. Please find more about the "Audio" question type here.


Generally, our pricing depends on three factors:

  1. The type of data you plan to collect (only surveys and experience sampling, or sensor data as well).
  2. The participation period (how long each participant will be enrolled in your study).
  3. The maximum number of participants you expect to enroll, in this case, is 100 participants.

We offer both project-based and annual subscription licenses. Annual subscription licenses allow for an unlimited number of projects to be conducted. Actually, this could be potentially more cost-efficient because our pricing schema is much more efficient for large-scale projects than for small ones. If you think you may run multiple studies within a year, it may make sense to buy a subscription license.


Please share the above information about your research with us so we can help you more effectively.


If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us, or the support team. You can also visit our support knowledge base which provides helpful hints for the entire platform as well as our forum page where other researchers share their questions and thoughts.


If you’d like, we can arrange a brief meeting to demo our product and discuss your project. Our calendar is shared here, and we have a flexible schedule from October 23rd onward.


Best,

Sara

--
Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)
4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada
Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com

Looking forward to hearing from you.

All the best,

Anna-Maria Mayer

subject: Welcome to Avicenna
body:
Dear Anna-Maria,

I hope all is well with you. My apologies for not getting back to you sooner.

Thank you for sharing details about your study with me. I’m here to help you with any questions you may have.

Based on the details provided, if you plan to have different participant groups and study settings, an annual subscription might be a more flexible choice. This subscription allows you to create multiple studies, making it easier to manage different groups.

The cost of the annual subscription licenses depends on the quota of the license. Our unit of measurement for the quota is called participant/week. Each participant/week, or P/W in short, represents the data that you can collect from 1 participant during 1 week. For example, 100 P/W means you collect data from 100 participants for 1 week. Now you can use this in any combination that you want. For example, instead of 100 participants for 1 week, you can conduct 2 studies with 50 participants each for 1 week, as the total again would be 100 P/W.

A quota of 500 participants/week would suit a project similar to yours. You can also divide it among more projects, as long as you don't exceed your quota.

> The total cost of this subscription license to collect survey response data will be CAD 1,497.90 (~ 1,004.26€) for the entire year.

This license doesn't impose any restrictions on the number of projects, researchers, notifications, questions, or surveys. To make more room available, I'd like to offer you the following suggestions:

  • Annual subscription license for 1000 P/W: CAD 1,947.90  (~ 1,305.96€) per year
  • Annual subscription license for 1500 P/W: CAD 2,397.90 (~ 1,607.66€) per year
  • Annual subscription license for 2000 P/W: CAD 2,847.12 (~ 1,908.84€) per year

As you can see, our pricing doesn't grow linearly and it's more efficient toward larger quotas than in smaller ones.


Alternatively, if you prefer to include all participants in a single study, a project-based license might be suitable. In this case, you would need to assign group IDs to participants and ask for these IDs in the baseline survey. You can then create various surveys, add Triggering Logics, and set the Criteria to direct participants based on their group identified in the baseline survey. It is also important to ensure the Participation Duration is set correctly. More information about this can be found here.

> The total licensing cost to collect survey data from 50 participants for 2 weeks and 50 participants for 7 weeks will be CAD 1,350.00 (~ 905.10€).

Please note that this option is limited to a single project and may not be as cost-effective as the subscription license, especially if you anticipate needing to run multiple projects within a year.

Sorry about the long email. I tried to cover all the topics to make sure you have the information you need to make an informed decision.

Please let me know if you have any questions. Our calendar is also shared here just in case.

Best,
Sara
--
Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)
4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada
Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com
